description: Natural Disasters happen during any age and are triggered whenever a player draws an Ace card. When this happens, the player who drew the card should decide what happens. Examples of natural disasters could be a volcanic eruption, an earthquake, a tsunami, a meteor, a plague, a tornado, etc.
